--- a/minbpe/basic.py
+++ b/minbpe/basic.py
@@ -236,3 +236,23 @@
-        prev = idx
-        app((chr(p0) + chr(p1), chr(idx)))
-    return table
+        prev = idx
+        a = chr(p0)
+        b = chr(p1)
+        app((a, b, a + b, chr(idx)))
+    return table
+
+
+def _apply_table(s, table):
+    """
+    Apply a _replace_table to the str s. A replace is skipped when one of its
+    pair's characters cannot be in s: present over-approximates the characters
+    of s (the initial ones plus every token minted so far), so a skipped
+    replace would not have matched anything.
+    """
+    present = set(s)
+    add = present.add
+    for a, b, ps, c in table:
+        if a in present and b in present:
+            t = s.replace(ps, c)
+            if len(t) != len(s):
+                s = t
+                add(c)
+    return s
